registryEvidence.custodian: Settlement and Land Records Department (SLRD), with a township-level land-records office evidenced in a Myaung Mya government notice

portalsFound.observation: Official SLRD department site; general institutional and news content, no parcel viewer or public feature endpoint found in the inspected page.
Official Survey Department landing page; direct browser-like GET timed out after 40 seconds from this environment.
Official MIMU GIS resource page lists administrative, roads, town/village and land-use datasets at intermediate scale; it does not present cadastral parcel polygons or native parcel IDs.
Myaungmya township page links a township profile and village-level KML; these are contextual/admin resources, not cadastral parcel data.
